fnol_text: My name is Leah Gallagher and I live at 191 Juniper Court, Fairview, PA 16468. You can reach me on (555) 731-1283 or leah.gallagher@example.com. On 4 June 2024 the Calder River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00022. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Gallagher on (555) 731-1283 to acknowledge the claim. Leah confirmed the loss date as 4 June 2024.
Site visit to 191 Juniper Court. Neighbour Anika Jovanovic was present and confirmed the timeline.
Leah sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
